'''Anna''' was a [[Gender/Legends|female]] [[Cathar/Legends|Cathar]] miner. In [[3631 BBY]] she was part of the mining group working on [[Ilum/Legends|Ilum]] for the [[Minos-Mestra Corporation]], who secured the minings rights from both [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] and the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|reconstituted Sith Empire]]. After the miners accidentally desecrated a burial cite of [[Xivhkalrainik's father]], his son, the Sith Lord [[Xivhkalrainik|Xalek]] began attacking their mining camps, slaughtering everyone and leaving no survivors. When Anna was at [[Shaft 12]], Xalek attacked it and began killing everyone. Anna contacted [[Shaft 16]] for help, but by the time it arrived, she was already dead.<ref name="SWTOR" />

==Behind the scenes==
Anna appears in ''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic: Knights of the Fallen Empire]]'' during Xalek Alliance alert mission.
